title: Claude Code output style frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of an output style file as Claude Code 2.1.321 reads it (Agent Plugins Extended 1.1.0, section 6.1.1). Every field is optional; an unknown key is ignored.
$comment: A style always loads: YAML that does not parse leaves its fields unset, and a value of the wrong type is treated as absent (section 6.1.1 items 4 and 5). So the root accepts any parsed frontmatter, and $defs/effective states the values that take effect.
